As Great Panther Silver LTD (GPL) Market Value Declined, Holder Financial & Investment Management Group LTD Increased Position; As Wal (WMT) Stock Declined, Shareholder Quantres Asset Management LTD Has Decreased Its Holding by $470,400
May 3, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Quantres Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Wal (WMT) by 48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quantres Asset Management Ltd sold 4,800 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.38% with the market. The institutional investor held 5,200 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $514,000, down from 10,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quantres Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Wal for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $252.11 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.04% or $0.9 $85.44. About 2.29 million shares traded. Walmart Inc. (NYSE:WMT) has risen 23.53% uptrending. It has outperformed by 11.98% the S&P500.
Financial & Investment Management Group Ltd increased its stake in Great Panther Silver Ltd (GPL) by 387.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Financial & Investment Management Group Ltd bought 3.40 million shares as the company’s stock declined 6.87% with the market. The institutional investor held 4.28 million shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.52 million, up from 876,971 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Financial & Investment Management Group Ltd who had been investing in Great Panther Silver Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $217.94 million market cap company. The stock increased 1.19% or $0.015 $1.275. About 210,844 shares traded. Great Panther Silver Limited (NYSEMKT:GPL) has declined 27.81% downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.36% the S&P500.
Financial & Investment Management Group Ltd, which manages about $825.08 million and $288.51 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Schwab Strategic Tr (SCHR) by 90,575 shares to 483,181 shares, valued at $25.76 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Schwab Strategic Tr (SCHO) by 172,496 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 597,953 shares, and cut its stake in Western Asset Clym Infl Opp (WIW).
